ayahOccurrences.text: وَكَيْفَ تَأْخُذُونَهُۥ وَقَدْ أَفْضَىٰ بَعْضُكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ وَأَخَذْنَ مِنكُم مِّيثَٰقًا غَلِيظًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَكَيْفَ تَأْخُذُونَهُۥ وَقَدْ أَفْضَىٰ بَعْضُكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ وَأَخَذْنَ مِنكُم مِّيثَٰقًا غَلِيظًا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form IV) perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: أَفْضَىٰ is in the derivative form: أفْضى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ف/ض/و   f–ḍ–w wide open space, to go out into the open; to be empty; to reach out to, to break the barriers between, to become close to; to occupy the space of. Of this root, أفْضَى ʾafḍā, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
أفْضى ʾafḍā [v. VI, intrans.] to break the barriers between, to occupy the space of, to become adjacent to, to come close to *

(4:21) ‏أَفْضَى ‏‏بَعْضُكُمْ‏ ‏إِلَى‏ ‏بَعْضٍ you have slept together [lit. one of you has come close to the other]. ‏
